# The One Man Sideshow

> A sourced city directory in thirty-five hours, run by one person and a fleet of AI agents. Made by Hongdam (หงส์ดำ), Chiang Rai. Contact: nan@motdang.net

## Offer
- The kit, do it yourself: free, https://github.com/NaNoBotCo/onemansideshow
- Set up for you, training included: 25,000 THB for Thai companies; 25,000 USD for everyone else
- For a town: a directory of the town, a LINE desk, campaigns on a calendar, an assistant on the town's records; price by email

## Proof, measured September 2026
- https://motdang.net/ : 88,888 places in Chiang Mai and Chiang Rai
- https://motdang.net/brief : the method and the numbers
- https://ask.motdang.net/ : the assistant
- https://nanobotco.github.io/index/ : 20 sites, 99,303 pages, 302,396 records, each count with its method
